## San Luis Obispo Museum of Art — November 2026

### Exhibition on view

- **_Vista: Selections from SLOMA’s Permanent Collection_**  
  **October 24, 2026–February 7, 2027**  
  This is SLOMA’s main gallery exhibition during November, featuring works from the museum’s permanent collection. ([sloma.org](https://sloma.org/?utm_source=openai))

- **Bunnie Reiss: _Bird Watching_**  
  **2026–2028** — outdoor mural project. ([sloma.org](https://sloma.org/exhibits/current/?utm_source=openai))

- **Bruce Johnson: _Sculpture Jam_**  
  **January 2026–2027** — public-art installation in San Luis Obispo. ([sloma.org](https://sloma.org/exhibits/current/?utm_source=openai))

### Museum hours

- **Thursday–Monday:** 11 a.m.–5 p.m.  
- **Tuesday–Wednesday:** Closed to the public; reserved school and group tours only  
- **Admission:** Free  
- **Address:** 1010 Broad Street, San Luis Obispo, CA 93401 ([sloma.org](https://sloma.org/visit/?utm_source=openai))

SLOMA is scheduled to be **closed on Thanksgiving, Thursday, November 26, 2026**. ([sloma.org](https://sloma.org/visit/?utm_source=openai))

### November programs

- **Weekly docent tour:** Every Saturday at 11 a.m.  
- **First Friday:** November 6, 5–8 p.m., with extended hours and music  
- **Second Saturday:** November 14, 11 a.m.–1 p.m.; the 2026 activity was listed as “TBD” on SLOMA’s calendar. ([sloma.org](https://sloma.org/visit/calendar/?utm_source=openai))
